//: Source-of-truth declaration for Firestore composite indexes.
Single-field indexes are auto-created by Firestore on first write, so
we only declare composite (multi-field) indexes here. Each entry below
exists because a query in src/ uses a `where(...).orderBy(...)` pattern
across two different fields, which Firestore cannot satisfy without
# or imperatively via gcloud (no Firebase CLI required):

indexes.//: Powers GET /api/recommendations — listActiveRecommendations() in src/services/firestore.js. Filters by status=Active and orders by submittedAt desc. Without this index that query throws (the GET handler degrades to an empty list, which renders as 'Be the first to leave a recommendation' even when records exist).
